description:
Estimate whether two variants in the same gene sit on different haplotypes (in trans — compound heterozygous) or on the same one (in cis), from gnomAD v2.1 exome genotypes: the probability of compound heterozygosity and the genotype and haplotype counts behind it, overall and per genetic-ancestry group. For a proband with two rare heterozygous variants in a recessive gene and no parental samples. Takes exactly two GRCh37 chrom-pos-ref-alt IDs and always reads gnomad_r2_1, the only dataset gnomAD serves co-occurrence for. A GRCh38 ID can name a different GRCh37 variant or none, so convert GRCh38 IDs first: gnomad_get_variant on dataset gnomad_r2_1 lists their GRCh37 IDs as candidates only when the ID fails there as variant_not_found_other_build; an ID gnomad_r2_1 finds returns a different variant. gnomAD answers only for two different coding or UTR variants of one gene, both in its exome samples with exome allele frequency of 5% or less; any other pair fails as cooccurrence_unavailable with gnomAD's reason. Every count key names variant_ids[0]'s genotype or allele first and variant_ids[1]'s second, and variant_ids can list the pair in another order than sent. The notice carries gnomAD's calibration caveat and its browser's reading of the probability. gnomAD's browser also notes when the pair is found in phase as a multi-nucleotide variant; this tool does not check for one.
Data source: gnomAD (Broad Institute) — https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/

variants.description: The two variants to phase, in any order.

items.description: GRCh37 variant ID — chrom-pos-ref-alt (1-based, e.g. 1-55505647-G-T) on chromosome 1–22, X, or Y, with an optional chr prefix.

name: gnomad_get_variant_cooccurrence

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_variant_id`: A variant is not a chrom-pos-ref-alt ID on chromosome 1–22, X, or Y — an rsID included, since co-occurrence takes coordinate IDs. `mitochondrial_unsupported`: A variant ID names the mitochondrial chromosome (M, MT, or chrM). `cooccurrence_unavailable`: gnomAD refused the pair — the same variant twice, one absent from gnomAD v2.1 (as a GRCh38 ID usually is), different genes, a variant outside coding and UTR sequence, or one with no exome call or a common exome frequency; the message is gnomAD's reason. `graphql_error`: gnomAD rejected the co-occurrence query with a GraphQL error other than a refusal of the pair. `upstream_unavailable`: gnomAD stayed unavailable or throttled through every retry. `upstream_timeout`: gnomAD attempts timed out or the shared 45 s call budget expired. `upstream_access`: gnomAD refused the request (access denied). `invalid_upstream_response`: gnomAD kept answering with a response that failed validation — counts of the wrong shape, or variant_ids naming a pair other than the one sent. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

genotype_counts.description: Samples per genotype pair: ref (homozygous reference), het (heterozygous), hom (homozygous alternate).

het_het.description: Samples heterozygous for both — the carriers whose phase is estimated.

haplotype_counts.description: gnomAD's estimated haplotype counts per allele pair, fractional where samples heterozygous for both variants leave the phase to its EM estimate.

alt_alt.description: Estimated haplotypes with both alternate alleles (in cis).

notice.description: gnomAD's calibration caveat and its browser's reading of the probability for this pair; when no sample carries both variants, also that the counts come from each variant's separate data and miss samples not covered at both sites.

p_compound_heterozygous.description: Estimated probability that the two variants lie on different haplotypes (in trans, compound heterozygous). Null when gnomAD computes none, as when either variant has no carrier among these samples — never read null as 0.

populations.description: The same counts per genetic-ancestry group, in gnomAD's order.

het_het.description: Samples heterozygous for both — the carriers whose phase is estimated.

alt_alt.description: Estimated haplotypes with both alternate alleles (in cis).

id.description: Genetic-ancestry group of gnomAD v2.1 exomes: afr, amr, asj, eas, fin, nfe, oth, sas.

p_compound_heterozygous.description: This group's probability, read as the overall one.

variant_ids.description: The pair in gnomAD's order, which labels every count.

title: gnomad-genetics-mcp-server: get variant cooccurrence
